    1. constructed(Object, Injector)

Interface ConstructionListener

Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface ConstructionListener
Observes the instances the container builds. Contribute one with @IntoSet(ConstructionListener.class); the root injector resolves every listener when it is created.

The generated factories call each listener synchronously, on the constructing thread, once an instance is fully built: after its constructor, member injection and @PostConstruct. That includes @Provides results, interception proxies and assisted products. Instances bound with bind(...) are not reported, nor are those built while the listeners themselves are being resolved: the listeners and their dependencies. An exception thrown by a listener fails that construction: the instance is neither cached nor destroyed.
